results.question: Mobilisation Advance
results.answer:
• Mobilization Advance: Applicable (Clause 10B(ii)). On a specific request, mobilization advance shall be considered for sanction up to a maximum of 10% of the quoted amount.
• Release Terms: Released in two equal installments (not later than 3 months); 1st installment against Bank Guarantee (110%) from a Scheduled Bank valid for the contract period (kept renewed to cover balance amount and interest).
• Plant, Machinery & Shuttering Material Advance: Restricted to 5% of tender value, released against Bank Guarantee (110%) from a Scheduled Bank valid for the contract period.
results.source: TechnicalBid.pdf, Page 36, Clause 10B (ii) & Prebid_Minutes.pdf, Page 16, Query 59

results.question: Interest Rate of Mobilization Advance
results.answer: Simple interest @ 10% per annum. Interest on the advance shall be calculated from the date of payment to the day of recovery, both days inclusive.
results.source: TechnicalBid.pdf, Page 36, Clause 10B (ii) (b)

results.question: Recovery of Mobilisation Advance
results.answer:
• Recovery shall commence after 10% of work is completed and the entire amount together with interest shall be recovered by the time 80% of the work is completed.
• It shall be ensured that at any point of time, Bank Guarantee is available for the amount of outstanding advances.
results.source: TechnicalBid.pdf, Page 36, Clause 10B (ii) (c) & (d)

results.question: Secured advance on materials
results.answer: Applicable as per Clause 10B(i) of CCC-2008: Secured advance on non-perishable materials will be 90% of the assessed value. When materials on account of which an advance has been made are incorporated in the work, the amount of such advance shall be recovered/deducted from the next payment made under any clause(s) of the contract.
results.source: Prebid_Minutes.pdf, Page 16, Query 60 (referencing CCC-2008 Clause 10B(i), Page 20)

results.question: Barricading
results.answer:
• Option 1: Construction layouts having area more than 01 (one) acre or Height more than 70m, shall have continuous dust or wind breaking tin / metal sheet erected of minimum height 35 feet around periphery of the construction project site and for construction site, less than 01 (one) acre, the tin / metal sheet height shall be 25 feet minimum.
• Option 2: The quoted rate shall be inclusive of providing and erecting temporary barricading of height as per 'Guidelines for Air Pollution mitigation' (but minimum 10 feet height) using structural steel (MS Pipes or angle iron frame work etc.), covered with tin / GI sheets of approved colour & shade, Struts, MS Clamps, Bracing etc. and shall have wicket gate & material gate and including writing and painting of direction & instructions, providing glow lamps, reflective signs, marking, flags, caution tape etc. Prior written approval of Engineer-in-Charge of sketch/drawing showing barricading details shall be obtained. Barricading shall be retained continuously during execution till completion. Contractor shall submit certificate for completion of barricading along with 1st RA bill after certifying by Engineer-in-Charge for releasing payment.
results.source: Important General Notes.pdf, Page 5, Notes 34(viii) & 35

results.question: Water spraying
results.answer: Water sprinkling shall be continuously carried out so that the debris shall remain in wet condition.
results.source: Important General Notes.pdf, Page 5, Clause 34(x)

• Barricading Signage: Barricading shall include writing and painting of direction & instructions, providing glow lamps, reflective signs, marking, flags, caution tape etc.
